case_number: Civil Appeal Nos. 77, 78, and 79 of 2023 (Arising out of SLP(C) Nos. 20784, 20904, 21924 of 2018); Transferred Case Nos. 28 and 29 of 2019

parties.respondent: State of Jammu and Kashmir & Ors

summary: Challenge to High Court's public interest litigation ruling prohibiting cinema owners from banning outside food/beverages; private property rights vs consumer rights; cinema tickets as contracts specifying terms; no statutory basis for restriction in 1975 Cinemas Rules; reliance on English contract law cases (Parker, Olley, McCutcheon, Thornton) inappropriate; High Court overstepped jurisdiction under Article 226; relief limited to prohibiting ban on outside food; final verdict not detailed in excerpted text.
